Real (non-stub) code is limited to constants/data tables, trivial pure data-mappings (CmisState as_str/from_db_str, value_to_py_str, strip_unit, VDM table-name formatters, xcvrd::pybool/stringify) and the infra seams, so non-ignored tests exercise only settled helpers.

milestones.title: Skeleton (deploy smoke)
milestones.goal: Rust crate compiles; the binary is injected into pmon and stays RUNNING under supervisor. Stand up DaemonXcvrd boot (init/run/deinit), the platform + STATE_DB seams, and the worker-thread scaffold without any table producers yet. Deploy-smoke gate only (harness special-cases M0 to check supervisor RUNNING).

DONE (skeleton): src/hal.rs + src/db.rs expose the trait Hal/SfpHandle + trait DbTable seams; src/xcvrd_utilities/xcvr_table_helper.rs carries the TRANSCEIVER_* table-name constants + XcvrTableHelper registry (constants real, registry wiring stubbed).
Translator: migrate the bootstrap boot path into xcvrd::DaemonXcvrd::{init,run,deinit} + spawn the (initially empty) worker-thread set, touching src/xcvrd/mod.rs.

Translator: new Rust boot smoke test for DaemonXcvrd::{init,deinit} over MockHal/MockDbTable (from tests/test_xcvrd.py:test_DaemonXcvrd_init_deinit_cold, kind=translate-directly).

milestones.title: Presence, identity & liveness
milestones.goal: On discovery/insertion read identity via the HAL and publish TRANSCEIVER_INFO (full CMIS dict vs. fixed SFF field list) + TRANSCEIVER_STATUS_SW.status=1/error=N/A; seed boot cmis_state=READY; on removal clear TRANSCEIVER_INFO and restore on re-plug. Retry a failed EEPROM identity read (60s cadence) and purge stale TRANSCEIVER_INFO at cold-start.
steps_part_a: xcvrd::post_port_sfp_info_to_db -- build the TRANSCEIVER_INFO field list (two shapes: CMIS dict vs fixed SFF list); return the PHYSICAL_PORT_NOT_EXIST/SFP_EEPROM_NOT_READY sentinels (src/xcvrd/mod.rs).
xcvrd_utilities::port_event_helper::get_port_mapping + PortMapping/PortChangeEvent -- build logical<->physical map from CONFIG_DB PORT (src/xcvrd_utilities/port_event_helper.rs).

SfpStateUpdateTask::{new,mapping_event_from_change_event,post_port_sfp_info_and_dom_thr_to_db_once,init_port_sfp_status_sw_tbl,retry_eeprom_reading,task_worker} -- the presence/identity state machine (src/xcvrd/sfp_state_update.rs).
xcvrd::DaemonXcvrd::remove_stale_transceiver_info -- purge INFO rows for absent ports at cold start (src/xcvrd/mod.rs).
xcvrd_utilities::common::{update_port_transceiver_status_table_sw,wrapper_get_presence} -- STATUS_SW status/error projection (src/xcvrd_utilities/common.rs).
steps_part_b: translate-directly: test_post_port_sfp_info_to_db + _with_sfp_not_present -> xcvrd::tests (INFO builder + sentinel) over MockHal/MockDbTable.

needs-new-test: test_wrapper_get_presence / test_wrapper_get_transceiver_info -> Rust HAL-seam tests over MockSfp (the _wrapper_* shim is provided scaffolding); test_SfpStateUpdateTask_task_run_stop -> Rust thread-stop test.

milestones.title: Multiport concurrency & table lifecycle
milestones.goal: Prove per-module isolation with all tasks running concurrently across many ports/subports (natsort breakout ordering, no cross-talk); and the full table-lifecycle contract: physical unplug + CONFIG_DB PORT_DEL delete the port's rows across the whole TRANSCEIVER_* set, a re-add repopulates them + reseeds NPU_SI_SETTINGS_SYNC_STATUS; warm/fast-reboot shutdown preserves TRANSCEIVER_STATUS/STATUS_SW (normal deinit deletes them).
steps_part_a: xcvrd_utilities::port_event_helper::PortMapping -- natsort breakout ordering + multi-port isolation across the concurrent task set (src/xcvrd_utilities/port_event_helper.rs).

xcvrd::DaemonXcvrd::deinit + xcvrd_utilities::common::is_syncd_warm_restore_complete -- warm/fast-reboot preserve vs normal-deinit delete of STATUS/STATUS_SW (src/xcvrd/mod.rs, src/xcvrd_utilities/common.rs).
steps_part_b: translate-directly: test_del_port_sfp_dom_info_from_db, test_sfp_removal_from_dict -> common::tests / xcvrd::sfp_state_update::tests (whole-table-set delete).
